snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles – Story Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on Sept 30, 2025. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/final-fantasy-tactics-the-ivalice-chronicles-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Uncover the long-hidden secrets of history's true heroes. Step into the story of ambition, betrayal, and honor that defined a generation. Ramza Beoulve, an aspiring knight of noble birth, and his companions are thrust into a journey of honor and sacrifice that will shape the future of the kingdom of Ivalice. 

#FINALFANTASYTACTICSTheIvaliceChronicles #NintendoSwitch #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
